name: OpenVibe.Git

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else

resumes.what: the database (repositories, stars, tokens and insights) is in PostgreSQL; the bare repositories are on disk under GIT_DATA_DIR and are the state themselves

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations are expand-only and run forward; the previous sha reads the same rows, so rolling the code back is safe

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site; repository writes take their own file and database locks

notes: Port 5270, unit openvibe-git.service. OpenVibe's own code home at git.openvibe.codes (plan OpenVibe_Git_Plan_2026-11-09): bare repositories on disk served by git's own http-backend behind OpenVibe sign-in, our pages and API for browsing, GitHub mirrors, stars, insights and contents writes without a clone. Codes, Run and Link act for a person with a typed service token and X-OV-Subject. It replaces Forgejo (deploy/forgejo in OpenVibe.Codes), whose data was all mirrors. G2 consumes Community community.comment.write and community.comment.moderate for hidden entity threads, Network network.notifications.push and identity.subject.resolve, and AI ai.run.create and ai.run.read with the selected model choices API. These are outbound grant requirements, not capabilities Git implements.

site.name: Git
site.what: Host code, browse it, mirror GitHub and clone it to your computer with Link, in OpenVibe's own theme.
